title: Get the robot to the charger
instruction: The robot stands bottom left, facing up. The charger is 2 squares higher and 3 squares to the right. Put the steps in order.
steps: The battery reports less than 20 %, set off
Stop and connect to the charger
why: The program waits until there is something to do: it sets off when the battery is running low.
The robot is facing up, so first it moves up 2.
Now it has to turn towards the charger. Without turning it would keep going up.
After the turn it faces right, and the charger is 3 squares away.
The process has to end: the robot stops at the goal.
debrief: A robot fills in nothing by itself. Every step must be unambiguous and the order exact, or it ends up somewhere else.
